# `count_if`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns the number of `TRUE` values for the expression.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
count_if(expr)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `agg_funcs` |
| Kind | aggregate (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- count_if, example 1
> SELECT count_if(col % 2 = 0) FROM VALUES (NULL), (0), (1), (2), (3) AS tab(col);
2
```

```sql
-- count_if, example 2
> SELECT count_if(col IS NULL) FROM VALUES (NULL), (0), (1), (2), (3) AS tab(col);
1
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 3.0.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
